Sugared Popcorn
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 11:01pm

Ingredients




1 cup sugar
1 tablespoon unsalted butter
3 tablespoons water
Couple drops red or green food coloring
6 cups popped butter-flavored popcorn
6 paper cones

Preparation

1 In a large, heavy pot over medium heat, combine the sugar, butter and water. Stirring constantly, cook until it is thick syrup, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the food coloring and popcorn and stir to coat evenly. Turn onto a sheet of parchment paper to cool. Serve in paper cones. 2 This recipe yields 6 servings.
